title: RRDS Signed Access Lookup Request v1
description: EIP-712 signed payload submitted to POST /v1/files/{fileId}/versions/{version}/access. Verified by gateway against authoritative AccessGovernance state and consumed atomically in PostgreSQL replay storage without submitting a blockchain transaction.

encryptionKeyVersion.description: Active encryption key version matching AccessGovernance memberIdentity.

operationNonce.description: One-time 32-byte operation nonce consumed atomically by the gateway replay store.

deadline.description: UTC Unix timestamp in seconds after which the signed request expires.

signature.description: 65-byte low-s secp256k1 EIP-712 signature (r || s || v) over AccessLookup under the RRDS AccessGovernance domain.
